claim: A new methodology for demonstrating ascertainability that was not properly raised before the district court is nonetheless preserved on appeal if the opposing party had an opportunity to file additional briefing on the issue.
initial_reasoning: The case at 357 F. Supp. 3d 363 addresses appellate preservation of new issues, holding that a new methodology for ascertainability can be preserved if the opposing party had the chance to file additional briefing.
